question: Does modelByChannel remain a competing runtime authority after its advertised removal?
verified_evidence: Current local config has runtimeByChannel with 11 Discord entries and no modelByChannel.
Message dispatch, fresh/normal reply, native slash fast path, gateway session display and harness defaults resolve runtimeByChannel.
Agent command model selection and status attribution still resolve modelByChannel; the old key also remains in schema, types, help, labels, validation, SDK exports and tests.
The focused resolver test intentionally proves disagreement for the same target: runtimeByChannel returns openai/gpt-5.5 and modelByChannel returns openai/gpt-5.4.
Commit 435059f7d6 is titled remove legacy channel model overrides but deliberately kept the old resolver independent; no migration or doctor path joins the two authorities.
The backup changelog file is untracked and unignored local residue, not a committed architectural authority.
Focused Vitest gate passed: 4 test files, 127 tests.
conclusion_so_far: Verified finding: the fork exposes two model-selection authorities whose consumers can disagree. Retire modelByChannel in the fork after a one-time compatibility check/migration, and make runtimeByChannel the single authority across execution and status paths.
